title: Police | Opa-Locka
column7: The city's current police page presents an active Opa-locka Police Department, says officers work around the clock, and lists a city police headquarters, records, investigations, traffic, and report-a-crime functions.

title: General Investigations Unit | Opa-Locka
column7: The General Investigations Unit page says detectives investigate crimes that occur within the city, which supports Opa-locka Police Department as the city's primary general-policing authority.

title: Final Five-Year Plan FY 24
key_finding: The city's FY24 five-year plan budgets a police function and shows police staffing of 50 sworn plus other personnel, confirming a city-run department rather than county replacement.

title: Ordinance / Resolution package on Miami-Dade sheriff transition (Matter 220728)
key_finding: Miami-Dade's 2022 sheriff-transition document says Miami-Dade Police serves unincorporated areas plus Miami Lakes, Palmetto Bay, and Cutler Bay, and separately states that the City of Opa-Locka provides municipal police services within its jurisdiction.

title: Florida Criminal Justice Agency Websites
key_finding: FDLE's criminal-justice agency links page lists Opa Locka Police Department and links to the city's police website, supporting a current official state-recognized agency identity.

title: ATMS Online Directory Search
key_finding: FDLE's ATMS directory search includes Opa Locka Police Department with ORI FL0131200, confirming a current official agency identity.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal report publishes Opa-Locka Police Department as a municipal row with population 18,090 and total index crime 1,242.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal report publishes Opa-Locka Police Department as a municipal row with population 16,570 and total index crime 869.

title: UCR Incident-Based Reports landing page
key_finding: FDLE states that Florida incident-based reporting data are published through downloadable FIBRS workbooks for 2021 and later periods.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q2 workbook
key_finding: Searching the official FDLE FIBRS workbook found no Opa-Locka, Opa Locka, FL0131200, or 0131200 row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q2 sheets.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0131200 exclusively to 12:municipal:place:1251650.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: FL0131200 is classified as a local police department, is marked as having SRS and NIBRS source presence across 2018-2024, but has nibrs_max_months_reported 0 and latest_srs_part1_total 0.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations show real CIUS-local annual counts in 2018-2019, then only zero-valued low-weight SRS annual rows from 2020 through 2024 and no NIBRS rows at all.

title: jurisdiction_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Jurisdiction-level observations mirror the agency break: Opa-locka has usable 2018-2019 CIUS-local support, then only zero-valued summary rows from 2020 through 2024.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Opa-locka offense controls are fully fill-backed because preferred reported support is zero and the row is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: jurisdiction_year_estimates.parquet
key_finding: Across offenses, the estimator treats 2019 as the last usable observed year for Opa-locka and fills 2020-2024 from trend or historical estimators.
